prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Selector Split Redesign: Redesign the pet picker into a dynamic split view with live previews and immediate trait badges. (why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion (60.9%) and long mean time (1017s), with reports of pet generation confusion.)
1: [choose_path, reorder] Defer Sign-In Post Pet Creation: Move sign-in after pet adoption so users form an emotional bond with their pet before committing to account creation. (why: Sign-in early in the flow drops 27% of users before they even see or choose a pet.)
2: [home, wait_info] Interactive Waiting Screen with Notification Toggle: Add progress bar, time estimate, and background desktop notification toggle during pet asset generation. (why: Waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, causing heavy user drop-off.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Simplified Starter Path Options Copy: Clarify path descriptions with clear expectations for instant preset adoption versus custom creation. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating initial hesitation and friction.)
4: [adoption, layout] Spotlight Adoption Certificate Stage: Switch adoption certificate layout to spotlight style with pet naming ceremony. (why: Adoption stage experiences high friction (60.9% pass rate), needing a celebratory milestone feeling.)

scores.note: Addresses the biggest funnel drop (60.9% pass rate) with direct user feedback support, but requires significant UI rework.
Reduces upfront friction at sign-in step (27% drop), though requires architectural flow changes.
Targets extreme latency (median 201s, mean 2336s) on home step to prevent abandonments during asset generation.
Low cost copy optimization addressing high mean decision time (514s) at path selection.
Adds celebration to high-drop adoption stage, though lacks explicit support ticket evidence for layout issues.
